short: An Iowa-class battleship, USS Missouri is best known as the site of the Empire of Japan's formal surrender ending World War II.
full:
Commissioned in 1944, USS Missouri was among the last and most advanced battleships built by the United States. Capable of speeds over 30 knots, she was designed to escort fast carrier task forces and provide devastating naval gunfire support with her 16-inch guns. She fought in the battles of Iwo Jima and Okinawa, surviving a kamikaze strike with minor damage.

On 2 September 1945, the formal surrender of Japan was signed aboard Missouri's deck in Tokyo Bay, concluding the deadliest conflict in human history. Unlike most of her contemporaries, she enjoyed a long post-war career, providing shore bombardment in the Korean War and Operation Desert Storm before her final decommissioning in 1992.
